independence_declaration.statement: code-security-reviewer authored no implementation in the DG1 scope (apps/**, packages/**, tools/deps/**, deploy/**, .github/workflows/ci.yml, docs/api/openapi.yaml, register). The verdict was formed from direct source review, a disposable clone of the frozen candidate and a throwaway PostgreSQL cluster, before reading any other round-1 review record (none was read).

checks_run.procedure: Confirm HEAD, complete clone, recomputed candidate ID; confirm the post-freeze commit touches only excluded metadata; recompute the candidate in a disposable clone checked out at the freeze commit.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG1; git diff --stat 85e5bbd..HEAD; (clone at 85e5bbd) node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG1
checks_run.environment: /home/user/My-owns (HEAD 863505e, metadata-only freeze commit) and $TMPDIR/review-sec (git clone --no-local, checkout 85e5bbd); Node 22.22.2
checks_run.expected: Complete clone; candidate sha256:7fcc4943...; only excluded docs/delivery paths changed after 85e5bbd
checks_run.actual: is-shallow=false; candidate_id sha256:7fcc4943694dc9d7d207b18b53c42eab1efa131da46b898f733ae20298b39367 (371 files) in both trees; 863505e changes only docs/delivery/{assignments,candidates,stages.json}

checks_run.procedure: Validate the preceding gate DG0 historically.
checks_run.command: node tools/gates/validate.mjs --stage DG0 --historical
checks_run.actual: PASS gate DG0 (historical)

checks_run.procedure: Type-check every workspace package.
checks_run.command: pnpm -r typecheck
checks_run.environment: disposable clone at 85e5bbd with the installed node_modules copied in; offline; Node 22.22.2, pnpm 10.33.0
checks_run.actual: all packages Done; exit 0

checks_run.procedure: Build every workspace package (api, worker, web, packages).
checks_run.command: pnpm -r build
checks_run.actual: all builds Done (vite web bundle built); exit 0

checks_run.procedure: ESLint with zero warnings.
checks_run.command: pnpm lint
checks_run.actual: no output; exit 0

checks_run.procedure: Validate the OpenAPI contract.
checks_run.command: pnpm openapi:lint
checks_run.actual: PASS docs/api/openapi.yaml: OpenAPI 3.1.1, 33 operations

checks_run.procedure: Scan apps and packages for public CDN references.
checks_run.command: pnpm check:no-cdn
checks_run.actual: PASS no-cdn: scanned apps, packages

checks_run.procedure: Unit suites (unit-node + unit-web).
checks_run.command: pnpm test
checks_run.actual: Test Files 15 passed (15); Tests 130 passed (130)

checks_run.procedure: Full integration suite against a disposable PostgreSQL (global setup creates a fresh database, applies all migrations through the real mth-db CLI as mth_owner, runs as mth_app). Repeated 3 times for determinism.
checks_run.command: TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL=postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:54391/postgres pnpm test:integration   (x3, via withpg.sh)
checks_run.environment: disposable clone at 85e5bbd; throwaway PostgreSQL 16.13 cluster (initdb under $TMPDIR, trust auth, 127.0.0.1:54391, fsync=off), removed afterwards
checks_run.actual: Run 1: 2 failed / 179 passed + 1 unhandled error (contract coverage: getBrandingTokens not exercised; transformations duplicate-code audit count 13 vs 11; worker maintenance 57P01). Runs 2 and 3: 1 failed / 180 passed (contract coverage only). 6 migrations applied to a fresh database each run.

checks_run.procedure: DG0 delivery controls still hold after the DG1 changes: run the gate and agent tooling suites; review the DG1 diff of tools/gates, tools/agents, .claude, delivery-gates.yml.
checks_run.command: node --test tools/gates/tests/*.test.mjs tools/agents/tests/*.test.mjs; git diff --stat 1e4c0226..85e5bbd -- tools/gates tools/agents .claude .github/workflows/delivery-gates.yml
checks_run.actual: tests 105, pass 105, fail 0. The only control change is tools/agents/agent_settings.py adding tools/deps to COMMON_DENY (a strengthening); tools/gates and delivery-gates.yml unchanged.

checks_run.procedure: Run the REQ-DLV-042 installer acceptance suite; first with the environment's default (read-only) pnpm store, then with a writable store in $TMPDIR.
checks_run.command: tools/deps/tests/install-sandbox.test.sh; npm_config_store_dir=$TMPDIR/pnpm-store tools/deps/tests/install-sandbox.test.sh
checks_run.environment: disposable clone at 85e5bbd; bubblewrap present; no network; reviewer sandbox (HOME read-only)
checks_run.actual: Default store: 6 pass / 1 fail (create failed with EROFS on the read-only store; AC-2 negative and AC-3(b) still reported PASS = vacuous, F-DG1-111). Writable store: 7 passed, 0 failed, exit 0.

checks_run.procedure: Probe what package code can reach from inside the installer sandbox: environment, capabilities, writes to repository control paths, remount attempts.
checks_run.command: FAKE_ORCH_SECRET=... tools/deps/install-sandbox.sh --root <clone> run -- bash -c '<env names; CapEff; write .git/hooks, .claude, tools/gates, .github; mount tmpfs; remount / rw>'
checks_run.environment: disposable clone; bubblewrap; uid 0; values of credentials were never printed (names only)
checks_run.expected: cleared environment; control paths read-only; capabilities dropped
checks_run.actual: Credentials visible by name (GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, CLOUDSDK_AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN, CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN, FAKE_ORCH_SECRET); CapEff 000001ffffffffff; .git/hooks/pre-commit, .claude/*, tools/gates/*, .github/workflows/* all writable; new tmpfs mount succeeds; remount of / rw refused.

checks_run.procedure: Plant six defects in the clone, one at a time, and run the full integration suite each time: remove the audit write of transformation archive, business-unit update, preferences update and assignment revoke; drop If-Match from user update; drop the business_unit.manage check from BU create.
checks_run.command: plant.sh <label> <file> <perl substitution> (applies, runs pnpm test:integration on a fresh DB, reverts)
checks_run.expected: each plant is caught by at least one dedicated test
checks_run.actual: 6/6 caught (transformations archive, organizations BU update, identity preferences, admin revoke, admin user disable If-Match, organizations BU create authz).

checks_run.procedure: Independent ADR-0006 probe: for 10 grant cases (TO org/BU/child BU, AUD BU, TL org/BU, SP transformation, ADM_TECH, ADM_ACCESS, TO other org) compare the SQL-filtered list with per-record reads, check siblings never cross, and check cross-scope PATCH and audit reads return 404; plus TL@BU create-then-read.
checks_run.command: npx vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/repro-scope-consistency.test.ts (copied into the clone)
checks_run.expected: list == read == expected set for every case; 404 on cross-scope write/audit
checks_run.actual: 11/11 pass: list and read agree in every case, siblings and other organizations never cross, technical admins see no business records, cross-scope PATCH/audit 404. Logged defect: TL@BU create 201 then read-back 404 (F-DG1-106).

checks_run.procedure: Reproduce whether the OIDC state is bound to the initiating browser (attacker obtains code+state, victim browser opens the callback).
checks_run.command: npx vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/repro-oidc-login-csrf.test.ts (copied into the clone)
checks_run.environment: disposable clone; throwaway PostgreSQL 16.13; local fake IdP with real openid-client validation
checks_run.expected: callback refused without the initiating browser's binding
checks_run.actual: callback 302; /auth/login sets no cookie; victim's browser signed in as attacker-sub; victim's original session 401 (F-DG1-103)

checks_run.procedure: Plant boundary violations in src/modules/transformations and run architecture.test.ts.
checks_run.command: npx vitest run --project unit-node apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts (per plant)
checks_run.actual: Detected: static deep import, literal dynamic import, re-export, disallowed module. Not detected: createRequire(...) and computed import() (F-DG1-109).

checks_run.procedure: REQ-DLV-025 structure check plus negative cases: removed needs, rogue job, unknown need, job-level if: always(), job-level if: !cancelled().
checks_run.command: node deploy/scripts/check-ci-needs.mjs (on ci.yml and on 5 planted variants)
checks_run.expected: OK on ci.yml; FAIL on every variant
checks_run.actual: OK on ci.yml (5 jobs, all reach delivery-gates). N1-N3 rejected (exit 1). N4 (if: always()) and N5 (if: !cancelled()) accepted with exit 0 (F-DG1-107).

checks_run.procedure: Run the packaging checks of the CI images job offline: .env.example names-only, SBOM up to date, image digests pinned.
checks_run.command: node deploy/scripts/generate-env-example.mjs --check; node licenses/generate-sbom.mjs --check; node deploy/scripts/pin-images.mjs --check
checks_run.actual: env-example OK (21 names, no values, exit 0); SBOM STALE (exit 1, lockfile hash only); pin-images 10 problems (exit 1) (F-DG1-108)

checks_run.procedure: Scan tracked files (excluding trading_agent and delivery records) for private keys, cloud/GitHub/API tokens and literal passwords; check .env.example, the Keycloak realm and the dev seed for values.
checks_run.command: git ls-files | xargs grep -I -E '(AKIA...|BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY|ghp_...|sk-...|xox[bp]-|password\s*[:=]\s*"...")'; grep on .env.example, deploy/keycloak/realm-mth-test.json, packages/db/seeds/dev/synthetic-dev-users.json
checks_run.actual: No matches (only the documented ci-only-not-a-secret CI database password). Realm credentials are ${...} placeholders; .env.example has names only; the seed has no credentials.

checks_run.procedure: Compose clean start, test-IdP login and the no-egress variant smoke (deploy/scripts/verify-stack.sh).
checks_run.command: docker info
checks_run.actual: permission denied on /var/run/docker.sock: the Compose stack and the no-egress smoke could not be run. Reviewed statically only (non-root image uid 10001, read_only, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, file secrets, internal network variant).

checks_run.procedure: Direct review of the full files in scope: access policy/rules/assignments/denials, identity (oidc, sessions, routes, users), organization, transformations, admin, audit, platform (hooks, idempotency, cursor, http, validation), server.ts, migrations 0001-0006, worker relay/handlers/queues, config loader, Dockerfile/entrypoint/Compose, ci.yml, install-sandbox.sh, modules.ts, architecture.test.ts; web token handling.
checks_run.expected: no unaddressed security or integrity defect
checks_run.actual: Sound: single policy function + SQL scope filter used by every list/read/write; registration-time access declaration and response-time fail-closed guard; 404/403 semantics; SoD trigger on role/permission/role_permission and policy guard; append-only audit (INSERT/SELECT grant + UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE triggers); If-Match 428/409 with row locks; transactional outbox with SKIP LOCKED, deterministic job id, consumer ledger, bounded retry + dead letter; Idempotency-Key with advisory lock; PKCE+nonce; hashed session tokens; HMAC CSRF + Origin check; strict CSP; dev login refused with NODE_ENV=production; no XSS sinks in apps/web. Defects: F-DG1-103, F-DG1-106, F-DG1-112 (and tooling F-DG1-102, 104, 107, 109, 111).

summary: FAIL. The product core is well built and the authorization/audit/concurrency invariants held under independent cross-scope probes and six planted defects. But the frozen candidate's integration suite fails (contract coverage of getBrandingTokens, High), the REQ-DLV-042 installer does not contain dependency code (credentials pass through, repo control paths writable, High), OIDC state is not browser-bound (login CSRF, Medium), CI does not use the installer, REQ-S16-003 is marked complete at DG1 although three named modules do not exist, and the CI images job cannot pass. Compose/no-egress checks are BLOCKED (no Docker daemon).
